_comment: POL — नेपाल में लोकतंत्र कैसे स्थापित हुआ (2025, 4 marks). All-Veo, vertical.
`green`: true means he is generated on flat chroma green and keyed onto the house plate,
because that line's screen has to carry text (years, the summary flow).
false means he is in the place he is describing, and only a short composited label goes over it.
Devanagari is NEVER generated: every label is composited afterwards.
Props carry NO writing: blank covers, smooth undyed cloth, plain paper. Veo cannot set Devanagari, so any prop with lettering comes back garbled — the march test came back with written banners.

1.camera: Medium shot at eye level, the camera holding still.
1.setting: stands in front of a flat, evenly lit chroma green wall that fills the frame behind him
1.before: He takes a breath, raises an index finger and looks into the camera
1.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and opens both palms towards the camera
1.sound: The only sound is his voice in a quiet room.

2.camera: Medium shot at eye level, the camera holding still.
2.setting: stands in front of the same flat, evenly lit chroma green wall
2.before: He tilts his head as if asking the question and looks into the camera
2.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and nods once
2.sound: The only sound is his voice in a quiet room.

3.camera: Medium tracking shot, framed tall, the camera moving backwards ahead of him at walking pace.
3.setting: walks through a busy hill-town market square in the Himalayan foothills at morning, plain cloth awnings and prayer flags behind him
3.before: He walks towards the camera through the crowd and looks up
3.after: He keeps walking as he speaks, then stops and looks around the square
3.others: Shoppers and traders go about their business around him.

4.camera: Low-angle medium shot, the camera holding still.
4.setting: stands on the road below a tall stone palace gate, soldiers standing far back at the gate
4.before: He looks up at the closed gate, then turns to the camera
4.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and glances back at the gate
4.others: Two uniformed guards stand at a distance by the gate.
4.sound: A cold wind and a far-off bell.

5.camera: Medium tracking shot, framed tall, the camera moving alongside at walking pace.
5.setting: walks at the edge of a small peaceful procession of townspeople holding candles and raising open hands
5.before: He falls into step beside the marchers, cups a hand around a candle flame and turns to the camera
5.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and lifts the candle a little as the group walks on
5.others: Ordinary people of all ages walk beside him, calm and determined, hands raised.
5.sound: Footsteps, voices and cloth snapping in the wind.

6.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
6.setting: stands on the wide stone steps of a government building, holding a thick cloth-bound volume with smooth blank covers in both hands
6.before: He climbs the last two steps, lifts the bound document and turns it towards the camera
6.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and holds the document against his chest
6.sound: A quiet street and a flag rope tapping its pole.

7.camera: Medium tracking shot, framed tall, the camera moving backwards ahead of him.
7.setting: walks down a long government corridor lined with closed office doors and empty chairs
7.before: He walks slowly past the empty chairs, brushing one with his hand, and looks at the camera
7.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and looks down the corridor
7.sound: Footsteps echoing in an empty corridor.

8.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
8.setting: stands in the middle of an emptied assembly chamber, curved rows of wooden seats around him
8.before: He rests a hand on the back of an empty seat and turns to the camera
8.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and looks along the empty rows
8.sound: A large empty hall, very quiet.

9.camera: Wide shot from the back of the hall, the camera holding still.
9.setting: stands alone at the speaker's desk of the same empty chamber
9.before: He places both hands on the desk and looks up into the camera
9.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and steps back from the desk
9.sound: A large empty hall, very quiet.

10.camera: Medium tracking shot, framed tall, the camera moving with him.
10.setting: walks inside a large peaceful daytime demonstration, people of all ages around him with open hands raised and smooth banners of plain undyed cloth
10.before: He walks among the marchers, raises a hand in greeting to them and looks into the camera
10.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and keeps walking with the crowd
10.others: A broad, calm crowd fills the street around him, hands raised.
10.sound: A steady murmur of voices and footsteps.

11.camera: Medium shot at eye level, the camera holding still.
11.setting: stands still at the front of the same peaceful crowd, people seated calmly on the road behind him with open palms raised
11.before: He looks at the seated demonstrators, then turns to the camera and holds up an open palm
11.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and lowers his hand slowly
11.others: Demonstrators sit calmly on the road, palms open and raised.
11.sound: Quiet voices and a soft breeze.

12.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
12.setting: stands with a group of organisers around a folding table on the roadside, rolls of plain undyed cloth stacked beside them
12.before: He leans over the table where the group is planning, straightens and turns to the camera
12.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and gestures towards the group
12.others: Seven organisers stand around the table, talking quietly.

13.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
13.setting: stands at the tall wooden doors of the assembly building as they are pushed open from inside
13.before: He steps aside as the doors swing open, then looks into the camera
13.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and looks through the open doors
13.others: An usher pushes the heavy doors open behind him.
13.sound: Heavy doors creaking open and distant applause.

14.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
14.setting: sits at a long committee table covered with smooth blank sheets of paper, members working along its length
14.before: He squares a blank sheet, sets his pencil down on it and looks up at the camera
14.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and slides the sheet to the member beside him
14.others: Members in plain clothes read and annotate along the table.
14.sound: Pages turning and pencils on paper.

15.camera: Medium shot at eye level, the camera holding still.
15.setting: stands beside the same committee table, a neat stack of blank pages in his hand
15.before: He sets the stack down on the table, straightens it and turns to the camera
15.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and rests a hand on the stack
15.others: Two members shake hands quietly behind him.
15.sound: Quiet voices and papers being squared.

16.camera: Low-angle medium shot, framed tall, the camera holding still.
16.setting: stands in a public square as a flag of one plain colour is hoisted on a tall pole above him
16.before: He helps pull the rope hand over hand as the flag rises, then looks into the camera
16.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and watches the flag climb
16.others: A small crowd watches the flag go up behind him.
16.sound: Rope on metal, wind and a cheering crowd.

17.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
17.setting: stands outside the assembly building holding a newly bound volume with smooth blank covers in both hands
17.before: He opens the book, turns one page and lifts it towards the camera
17.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and closes the book
17.sound: A calm street and a flag rope tapping its pole.

18.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
18.setting: stands in a formal meeting room where two flag stands hold flags of plain colour side by side
18.before: He walks between the two flag stands, touches one lightly and turns to the camera
18.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and looks from one flag to the other

19.camera: Medium shot at eye level, the camera holding still.
19.setting: stands in front of the flat, evenly lit chroma green wall again
19.before: He counts off on his fingers as he begins, and looks into the camera
19.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and opens both palms
19.sound: The only sound is his voice in a quiet room.

20.camera: Medium shot at eye level, the camera holding still.
20.setting: stands in front of the flat, evenly lit chroma green wall
20.before: He raises four fingers and looks into the camera
20.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and smiles
20.sound: The only sound is his voice in a quiet room.

21.camera: Medium shot at eye level, the camera holding still.
21.setting: stands in front of the flat, evenly lit chroma green wall
21.before: He points towards the side of the frame and looks into the camera
21.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and smiles slightly
21.sound: The only sound is his voice in a quiet room.
